attributes.residual: FOUR NEW CLOSURES, all real 0, none of them in HV's named roster. (1) ProcessCritter, game/enemy/critter, 420 insns, real 3 -> 0: form at +0xb4 (`li r30,0` vs `mr r30,r29`, dominating_def discharged at +0xac) plus a two-word r30->r29 recolor at +0x4dc/+0x528. NO PERMUTATION STAGE - see the method finding below. (2) calc_wizard_pos, game/ui/auxscreen, 55 insns, real 10 -> 0: permute [0x58,0x6c) order [0,3,2,1,4] sinking an `fcmpu cr0,f2,f4` two slots past an addi and a dependent lfs, plus an r5<->r6 transposition. (3) next_boss_hint and (4) next_legend_hint, game/ui/options, 100 insns each, real 14 -> 0 each: a single transposition of `lwz r0,0(r4)` with `lis r3,gPlayers@ha` over [0x10c,0x128), plus r0<->r4 and r5<->r6 transpositions. The two are siblings whose windows are byte-identical, so they share order and both region hashes and differ only in whole-function hashes. METHOD FINDING worth carrying forward: an automated order search will happily return the IDENTITY permutation when the function needs no reorder at all, because the identity trivially satisfies every dependence check. ProcessCritter came back that way. Shipping it would have pinned a region hash for a mechanism that does not exist and misdescribed a pure form+recolor residual as a schedule one, so the rule was re-derived with no permutation stage. Any future search should treat an identity order as a signal to DROP the stage, not as a closure. MEASURED NON-MEMBERS, recorded so they are not re-probed: next_rune_hint (sibling of the two that closed) refuses at step 0 on `breaks def-use chains: [(N,('g',5))]` over all five windows tried - C1's recolor-induced-displacement class; DoEnemyAction refuses on (1,('g',3)) and additionally its target reads a DIFFERENT base register (r27 where ours reads r3, two registers holding equal values), which is neither a form change nor a renaming and is outside every existing edit class; fn_800C37C4 refuses on (2,('g',6)); fn_80051164 admits no order; init_all_dir_info refuses because the reorder changes the final write of `mem`; FontInit is NOT a postprocessor candidate at all - its non-register word is our `rlwinm r30,r27,2,0,29` against the target's `addi r30,r27,0`, a genuine arithmetic difference (a scale-by-4 we emit and the target does not), i.e. real source work; debug_camera_pos reaches a consistent-recolor refusal at +0x9c on an FPR; towerRuneNearAudio, fn_8005FDA8 and CTriListCollide have windows of 9-20 atoms, beyond the 8-atom exhaustive search bound, and are left for a smarter derivation.
